text: Nobody moved more overnight than Jon Ossoff, who lost 0.5 points and now trades at 25.6. Both books agreed on the direction, with Kalshi moving 1.0 point and Polymarket 0.1 points. Kalshi's market on whether Van Hollen runs at all dropped 32 points, to 23 percent, even though Van Hollen's nomination price barely moved. In the simulations Ossoff went from 20 to 19 percent of first-place finishes. Jon Ossoff leads the markets at 26, but the model likes AOC, who wins 30 percent of simulated primaries. About 11 in 100 simulated primaries end without a pledged majority, which sends the fight to the convention floor. Watch the Ossoff price first when the books update tonight.
